title: structuredData.fetch input
description: Read structured datasets or Stage1 rollups. listVersions and version are dataset-only; kind mode rejects these options with structuredData.fetch-specific OODS-V202.

dataset.description: Local structured dataset to return (components/tokens/manifest). Mutually exclusive with kind+runPath.

kind.description: Stage1 structured artifact kind to read from runPath. Requires runPath; mutually exclusive with dataset. The rollups (identity_graph, capability_rollup, object_rollup, drift_report 1.0.0–1.4.0) and the run-view kinds at their pinned versions: a11y_report 2.2.0–2.5.0, report_index 1.0.0/1.1.0, a11y_evidence (evidence manifest 1.1.0–1.4.0, every per-page axe file read only when its sha256 matches the run manifest's attestation) and run_manifest (historical unstamped shape or schema_version 1.0.0 through 1.7.0; a suite's root, which records its targets, is refused). derived_analysis reads a directory containing manifest.analysis, admitting analysis 1.0.0/1.1.0, run_manifest 1.0.0–1.7.0, drift_report 1.0.0–1.4.0, report_index 1.1.0 and fig_local_tokens version 1.0.0/1.3.0/1.5.0 with retained-file attestation, lineage, realpath and JSON-pointer checks. Any other version is refused.

runPath.description: Filesystem path to a Stage1 run directory or its artifacts/ subdirectory. Required when kind is set.

ifNoneMatch.description: Return matched=true without payload when the ETag matches.

includePayload.description: When false, omit payload even if no ETag match occurs.

version.description: Request a specific date-stamped version (e.g., '2026-02-24'). Omit for latest. Applies to dataset mode only.

listVersions.description: When true, return available version dates instead of payload.

includeInternal.description: Live components dataset only: also list OODS Foundry's internal (non-business) objects, after the business objects. Without it they are left out and registry.hiddenInternal counts them; a dated export is served unchanged.
